name: macros: recording starts from the Tools command and shows in the status bar
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('flange'); await sleep(1200); await m.run('macroRecord'); await sleep(200); const rec = document.querySelector('#statusbar .macro-rec'); return JSON.stringify({ on: m.macro.state().recording, bar: Boolean(rec), text: rec?.textContent ?? '' }); })()

name: macros: a fillet edited through the tree and the PropertyManager is recorded as four steps (not what they call inside)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const f = m.project.parts[0].features.find((x) => x.type === 'fillet'); window.__fillet = { id: f.id, r0: f.radius }; m.actions.select([{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: `feat:${f.id}` }]); await sleep(100); await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(400); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('radius', '3.5', 'length'); await sleep(400); await m.actions.pmCommand('ok'); await sleep(600); const steps = m.macro.state().steps.map((s) => s.call); const r1 = m.project.parts[0].features.find((x) => x.id === f.id).radius; return JSON.stringify({ steps, changed: r1 === 3.5 && window.__fillet.r0 !== 3.5 }); })()

name: macros: a sketch drawn on the front plane is recorded with its contents before the step that closes it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.select([{ kind: 'plane', id: 'front', key: 'plane:front' }]); await sleep(100); await m.run('sketch'); await sleep(800); const ed = m.state.editing?.editor; const { addRectangle } = await import('/src/cad/sketch.js'); addRectangle(ed.sketch, 70, 10, 90, 30); ed.solve(); ed.commit('op.test'); await sleep(200); await m.run('sketch'); await sleep(600); const st = m.macro.state(); const calls = st.steps.map((s) => s.call); const set = st.steps.find((s) => s.call === 'setSketch'); window.__sketches = m.project.parts[0].features.filter((x) => x.type === 'sketch').length; return JSON.stringify({ tail: calls.slice(-4), lines: set?.args?.[0]?.entities?.filter((e) => e.type === 'line').length }); })()

name: macros: stopping writes the script and opens the editor window with it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('macroStop'); await sleep(1500); const st = m.macro.state(); const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((f) => /popup=macro/.test(f.src)); const area = frame?.contentDocument?.querySelector('[data-macro-text]'); window.__script = st.text; return JSON.stringify({ off: !st.recording, lines: st.text.split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('await mm.')).length, field: /await mm\.field\("radius", "3\.5", "length"\);/.test(st.text), sketch: /await mm\.setSketch\(\{/.test(st.text), editor: Boolean(area) && area.value === st.text }); })()

name: macros: after undoing what was recorded, Run in the editor window plays it back — the fillet radius and the sketch come again
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(300); await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(400); const before = { r: m.project.parts[0].features.find((x) => x.id === window.__fillet.id).radius, sketches: m.project.parts[0].features.filter((x) => x.type === 'sketch').length }; const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((f) => /popup=macro/.test(f.src)); frame.contentDocument.querySelector('[data-action="macro-run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && (m.macro.state().running || !m.macro.state().log.some((l) => l.level === 'ok')); i++) await sleep(200); const after = { r: m.project.parts[0].features.find((x) => x.id === window.__fillet.id).radius, sketches: m.project.parts[0].features.filter((x) => x.type === 'sketch').length }; const log = m.macro.state().log.map((l) => l.level); const shown = [...frame.contentDocument.querySelectorAll('.macro-log li')].length; return JSON.stringify({ undone: before.r === window.__fillet.r0 && before.sketches === window.__sketches - 1, r: after.r, sketches: after.sketches === window.__sketches, ok: log.includes('ok') && !log.includes('error'), shown: shown >= 2 }); })()

name: macros: a hand-written macro with a loop and the model data runs; an error is logged with its line and clicking it selects that line
macros: the console prompt evaluates at once; Stop ends a long macro; the script saves (no dialog)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((f) => /popup=macro/.test(f.src)); const doc = frame.contentDocument; const input = doc.querySelector('[data-macro-eval]'); input.value = 'mm.parts().length * 10'; input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); await sleep(500); const result = m.macro.state().log.filter((l) => l.level === 'result').at(-1)?.text; const area = doc.querySelector('[data-macro-text]'); area.value = 'while (true) { await mm.wait(50); }'; area.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(350); doc.querySelector('[data-action="macro-run"]').click(); await sleep(400); const running = m.macro.state().running; doc.querySelector('[data-action="macro-stop"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && m.macro.state().running; i++) await sleep(100); const stopped = !m.macro.state().running && m.macro.state().log.some((l) => l.level === 'warn'); let saved = null; window.showSaveFilePicker = async (o) => ({ name: o?.suggestedName ?? 'x', createWritable: async () => ({ write: async (b) => { saved = typeof b === 'string' ? b : await b.text(); }, close: async () => {} }) }); doc.querySelector('[data-action="macro-save"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 30 && saved == null; i++) await sleep(100); return JSON.stringify({ result, running, stopped, saved: saved === area.value }); })()
